reviews.title: Was excellent.  Now buggy abandonware.
reviews.text:
Forscore was recommended to me for readIng renaissance polyphony from facsimile editions.  I’ve now been using it for several months, and I’m hooked.  Goodbye to struggling with crufty, dog-eared paper copies in poor light!  It’s hard to think of any comment that hasn’t been made here before, except that...
... in another life I have to read technical manuals in PDF form, and I needed an app in which to make marginal notes.  It took an embarrassingly long time to realise that I already had one.

Update (after several years use):  I'm downgrading this to 2 stars for the following reasons:
1. The developer, a single programmer it seems, appears to have lost interest in this program, and neither posts updates nor responds to bug reports.
2. There are long-standing bugs that can require an app hard-restart during rehearsal/performance:
2.1. The spontaneous, random, event of appearance of the page-scroll-thumbnail, obscuring part of the page, and persisting until an app hard-restart, and
2.2. The inability to turn pages after hiding the default annotation layer, for which the workround seems to require an app hard-restart followed by the creation of a score-layer.

Beware getting locked-in to this app.  With hundreds of scores and countless hours of annotations, I find myself trapped in a proprietary format with no migration path out of it.

Way to go "restructuring" the menus so that everyone who’s used the app for years has no idea what’s going on. Backstage mayhem before a show because of this mess. Awful. Company don’t care, never respond to queries and block irate users on the socials.

Major major flaw in what is usually a very solid app. Every so often a setlist’s score will incorrectly have the same audio file attached to every song/score, regardless of what is supposed to be. Only an iPad restart will fix it which is not remotely acceptable during a live performance. Have used this app for a decade I have never known such an awful, show stopping bug. Please fix it and pronto!

reviews.title: Why is this App Getting Worse?
reviews.text: Since the version release with iPadOS 26, this app is considerably harder to use. Icons have been added that weren’t necessary and standard functions that didn’t need changing were changed. Why? The fact that you can no longer just tap the middle of the screen to clear the sidebar navigation—like all other apps—is super annoying, and is very clunky during performances. Why does forScore now force you to remember that you navigating in bookmarks versus a full score list to remove the menu? Is this something I need to think about during a performance when I need to find a score quickly? I’m a Pro member, but these are basic functions that, if not fixed, will definitely cause me to look for another app.

reviews.title: No more sync
reviews.text: The sync page in the app says I need to update forScore, and won’t let me sync my scores and setlists anymore. Thee is no update offered for me in the AppStore. Why are you removing core functionality to customers who paid for your product?
